updates.title: App Updates
updates.hint: Checks for a newer FormuLab release — does not download or install anything
updates.offlineHint: Could not reach the update server — check your connection and try again.
updates.platformNote: A build for your platform was found in this release.
updates.platformMissingNote: No build for your platform was found in this release's assets.
updates.ignoredNote: You're ignoring version {{version}} — it won't be flagged as available again unless a newer version is released.
updates.autoCheckHint: Checks once per launch, at most as often as the frequency below
updates.frequencyHint: How often an automatic check is allowed to run
updates.showBadgeHint: Show a dot on Settings when an update is available
updates.disclaimer: FormuLab checks for updates only — it does not download or install them. Use View Release / Download to get the new version from the release page.

workspace.hint: Local-first — each session works in its own dated subfolder created here

dataLocation.title: Active Data Location
dataLocation.hint: Where your formulations, master data, sessions and formulas actually live right now, and how to safely move them

kind.empty: Empty folder — ready to move your data here
kind.sameAsCurrent: This is already the active location

dataLocation.confirmMoveTitle: Move your data to this location?
dataLocation.confirmMoveHint: A verified safety backup is made first. Your data is copied and checked (size and SHA256) before anything is activated, and your current location is kept untouched until the move succeeds. Destination: {{destination}}
dataLocation.confirmUseExistingHint: A safety backup of your current data is made first. Nothing is copied — FormuLab will start reading and writing at this folder's existing data. Destination: {{destination}}
dataLocation.confirmRestoreDefaultHint: Clears your chosen workspace folder and falls back to the built-in default (~/Documents/FormuLab). This only changes where FormuLab looks — no files are moved or deleted.
dataLocation.safetyBackup: Safety backup of your previous data
dataLocation.confirmCleanupHint: Permanently deletes everything at {{path}}. Your data has already been safely moved and verified at the new location — this only removes the now-unused copy. This cannot be undone.
dataLocation.interruptedTitle: An earlier move did not finish
dataLocation.interruptedHint: FormuLab was closed or crashed while moving data to {{destination}}. Resuming will safely finish the move if it's safe to do so, or roll back to your previous location.
dataLocation.recoveredRolledBack: The interrupted move was rolled back

toast.restoreDefaultFailed: Could not restore the default location
toast.cleanupFailed: Could not delete the old location
toast.resumeFailed: Could not resume the interrupted move

backup.title: Backup and Recovery
backup.hint: Save a portable copy of your formulations, master data, sessions and run history, or restore from one
backup.confirmTitle: This will replace your current data
backup.confirmHint: A safety backup of your current data is made automatically before anything is changed, and the restore is rolled back if anything fails.

summary.safetyBackupAt: Safety backup of your previous data:

toast.inspectFailed: Could not read the backup package
toast.verifyFailed: Could not verify the backup package

automaticBackup.title: Automatic Backups
automaticBackup.hint: Create and verify backups on a schedule, using the same backup package Backup and Recovery uses
automaticBackup.enabledHint: Turn on daily/weekly scheduled backups and backup on exit
automaticBackup.destinationHint: Where daily and weekly backups are written — pre-migration backups always stay in FormuLab's own private storage
automaticBackup.dailyHint: At most once every 24 hours while FormuLab is open
automaticBackup.weeklyHint: At most once every 7 days while FormuLab is open
automaticBackup.onExitHint: Create a backup when you close FormuLab, if one hasn't already run today
automaticBackup.preMigrationHint: FormuLab always backs up your data before a schema migration — this only limits how many of those are kept
automaticBackup.limitationNote: Automatic backups only run while FormuLab is open — there is no background service. A day or week where the app never opens simply has no automatic backup for that day or week.

toast.saveFailed: Could not save automatic backup settings

migration.title: Schema Migration
migration.hint: Keeps your data files up to date with this version of FormuLab, with a safety backup and rollback if anything goes wrong
migration.nothingPending: Nothing to migrate — every collection is already current.
migration.rolledBackYes: Your data was restored from the pre-migration backup.
migration.rolledBackNo: Rollback could not complete automatically — restore the pre-migration backup manually from Backup and Recovery.
migration.rejectedHint: Your data is at schema version {{current}}, which is newer than this build supports ({{supported}}). Update FormuLab before opening this project again.
migration.interruptedTitle: An earlier migration did not finish
migration.interruptedHint: FormuLab was closed or crashed during a schema migration. Restore the pre-migration backup to return to a known-good state.

toast.loadFailed: Could not check the schema version

dataFlow.title: Privacy & data flow
dataFlow.subtitle: What stays on this machine, and exactly what leaves it.

local.heading: Stays on this machine
local.workspaceFiles: Your workspace files and raw data
local.codeExecution: Code execution — the Python kernel and Jupyter run locally; datasets are processed here, never uploaded in bulk.
local.sessionHistory: Session history and provenance records, in the app's private data folder.
local.providerKeys: Provider keys and login tokens — an app-private file readable only by your account; never written to the workspace, provenance, logs, or exports.

remote.heading: Sent to your model provider
remote.messages: Your messages, and the file contents / command output the agent reads to do the task you asked for.
remote.notBackground: Nothing is sent in the background — data leaves only during a conversation turn.
remote.providerPolicy: What the provider retains is governed by its own data policy.

dataFlow.skillsHint: Skills and MCP servers you add may make their own network calls — review them before installing.
